problem_text: Compute the Euler characteristic χ(Gr(3, 7)) of the real Grassmannian of 3-planes in R^7.
verification_method: Real Grassmannian Schubert calculus: for odd k and odd n, the antipodal/reflection map has no fixed points on unoriented cells, forcing χ = 0.

problem_text: Compute the abelianization of the fundamental group of the wedge sum S¹ ∨ S¹ ∨ S¹.
verification_method: π_1(S¹ ∨ S¹ ∨ S¹) = F_3 (free group on 3 generators). Ab(F_3) = F_3 / [F_3, F_3] ≅ Z³.

problem_text: Compute the first Betti number b₁ = dim H¹(𝔫) for the standard 3-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra 𝔫 with basis {X, Y, Z} and [X, Y] = Z.
verification_method: 1-forms are generated by {e^X, e^Y, e^Z}. de^Z = -e^X ∧ e^Y ≠ 0, de^X = 0, de^Y = 0. ker(d₁) = span{e^X, e^Y}, so b₁ = 2.

problem_text: Compute the Minkowski bound constant factor c = (4/π)^{r₂} (n! / nⁿ) for a totally complex quartic number field (r₁=0, r₂=2, n=4).
In d spacetime dimensions with Clifford algebra {γ^μ, γ^ν} = 2η^{μν}, evaluate the contraction γ_μ γ^α γ^β γ^μ.
verification_method: Using γ_μ γ^α = 2η_μ^α - γ^α γ_μ: γ_μ γ^α γ^β γ^μ = 4η^{αβ} - (4-d)γ^α γ^β = 4η^{αβ} + (d-4)γ^α γ^β.

problem_text: Compute the second non-zero eigenvalue λ₂ of the Laplacian -d²/dx² on [0, π] with Dirichlet boundary conditions u(0) = u(π) = 0.
verification_method: Eigenvalues are λ_n = n² for n = 1, 2, 3... First non-zero is λ₁ = 1, second non-zero is λ₂ = 2² = 4.
